presentation.name: Otávio Mendes Santos
presentation.description: Software development focused on backend and high performance. Practical experience creating resilient APIs, data modeling, DevOps practices, and modern interface development.

skills.title: Technical Stack
skills.headline: Backend, data, infrastructure, and modern interfaces.
skills.description: I work across the full development lifecycle, with a current focus on scalable backend services, API architecture, and production systems operation.

backend.title: Scalable services and integrations
backend.description: Building APIs, microservices, and communication flows between systems.
points: Building scalable and secure RESTful APIs.
Designing services focused on availability and concurrency.
Integrating authentication, real-time events, and external services.

frontend.title: Web, mobile, and whitelabel products
frontend.description: Creating and evolving responsive interfaces for digital products.
points: Componentizing screens and flows with maintainability in mind.
Implementing whitelabel experiences and high-fidelity interfaces.
Optimizing visual performance across web and mobile applications.

database.title: Consistent data and efficient queries
database.description: Modeling, maintaining, and optimizing data for production applications.
points: Modeling entities, relationships, and business rules.
Organizing persistence to reduce inconsistencies and rework.

infrastructure.title: Deploy, monitoring, and operation
infrastructure.description: Configuring environments, pipelines, and operational visibility.
points: Provisioning environments for development and production.
Tracking metrics, events, and service health.
Supporting more predictable, traceable, and secure deploys.

uiux.title: UI/UX Development
uiux.description: Development of responsive UI/UX for web and mobile using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SASS, Tailwind, and WordPress.

backend.title: Back-end Development
backend.description: End-to-end development with Node.js and Express, creation and refactoring of APIs, integration with PostgreSQL, and real-time communication via WebSocket.

refactoring.title: Optimization and Quality
refactoring.description: Refactoring, optimization, and bug fixing, ensuring performance, stability, and maintainability of applications.

highPerformanceSystems.title: High-Performance Systems
highPerformanceSystems.description: Developed and maintained highly available microservices in Go (Golang), optimizing the backend to support loads above 1000 ops/s.

cloudNativeInfrastructure.title: Cloud-Native Infrastructure
cloudNativeInfrastructure.description: Configured and managed environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud Secrets, and VM instances, ensuring serverless scalability and security.

observability.title: Observability and Monitoring
observability.description: Implemented observability dashboards in Grafana, using PostgreSQL and Prometheus as data sources and GitHub Webhooks integration for event monitoring.

dataAndEnvironments.title: Data and Environment Management
dataAndEnvironments.description: Configured and administered MongoDB Atlas clusters, handling the provisioning and maintenance of development and production environments.

refactoring.title: Mobile Refactoring
refactoring.description: Actively participated in the refactoring of the mobile app for delivery drivers, collaborating with the team to make it more performant, modern, and intuitive.

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
bestPractices.description: Contributed to the adoption of development best practices, focusing on modularity, scalability, and maintainability.

interfaces.title: Interface Implementation
interfaces.description: Implemented complete interfaces and navigation flows based on detailed prototypes in Figma, strictly respecting design guidelines.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Implemented and maintained the application's internationalization, using modern tools for translation and multi-language support.

systemRefactoring.title: System Refactoring
systemRefactoring.description: Participated in refactoring the company's main system alongside the front-end team, making it more performant, modern, and intuitive, with new features and better user experience.

challengeResolution.title: Challenge Resolution
challengeResolution.description: Solved technical challenges with creative and efficient approaches, contributing innovative solutions adopted as best practices by the team.

componentDevelopment.title: Component Development
componentDevelopment.description: Developed and maintained components such as dynamic forms, interactive maps, support for multiple brands (whitelabel), and global notification system (snackbar), focusing on modularity and usability.

typescript.title: TypeScript Typing
typescript.description: Created and maintained global types, interfaces, and DTOs in TypeScript, promoting consistency between application layers and reducing integration errors.

bugFixing.title: Bug Resolution
bugFixing.description: Worked on identifying and resolving bugs, collaborating with the back-end team to ensure system stability and improve communication between layers.

libraryImplementation.title: Library Implementation
libraryImplementation.description: Researched, tested, and implemented libraries that best fit the project's needs, focusing on performance, usability, and maintainability.

stateManagement.title: State Management
stateManagement.description: Implemented and maintained global state management, ensuring predictability, data consistency, and facilitating system scalability.

react.title: React
react.description: Intensive course on React, covering from basic syntax to advanced concepts like Hooks and Context API. Includes a final project where we developed a complete application (Dogs).

javascript.title: JavaScript
javascript.description: Complete JavaScript training, covering from fundamentals to advanced techniques. The course includes the use of classes, objects, web APIs, design patterns, and DOM manipulation.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.description: Intensive course on TypeScript, covering from basic syntax to advanced concepts like Interfaces and Data Typing.

reactWithTypeScript.title: React with TypeScript
reactWithTypeScript.description: Intensive course on React with TypeScript, covering from basic syntax to advanced concepts like Hooks and Context API.

flexbox.title: FlexBox
flexbox.description: Course focused on CSS Flexbox, addressing properties such as flex, flexShrink, and flexGrow to create responsive and flexible layouts.

gameDevJs.title: JavaScript Game Development
gameDevJs.description: Introduction to game development using JavaScript, addressing basic concepts of game programming and creating interactivity. Includes projects made during the course (Virtual Piano, Ralph Wreck-It Game, Memory Game, etc).

kotlinBackend.title: Kotlin Back End Development
kotlinBackend.description: Introduction to backend development using Kotlin, covering language fundamentals and the creation of APIs and services.

clearKanban.name: Clear Kanban
clearKanban.description: A Kanban application designed to efficiently and collaboratively manage demands. It offers features such as user authentication, email password recovery, and real-time communication using WebSockets, ensuring instant updates and a smooth user experience.
